ambient_events: The swell travels through and sets down again somewhere behind you.
Out east the Echelon shows one white light and nothing else.
description: Open water off the Glasshouse shore, out past the shelter of the inlet where the chop starts to stand up properly. The Glasshouse is a wall of lit glass to the south and the Echelon lies off to the east, black and enormous and not moored to anything of ours.
name: Coldwater Basin
